column1: # The desktop end-to-end's cases, in the order run.mjs runs them (a need's provider before the
# cases needing it): a case's id, its spec (specs/<spec>.mjs), the form it runs a lab in (- for
# none), the knobs it reads (- for none) and the groups it belongs to (--group: a group holds the
# providers of its cases' needs, so `launch` is in two). The specs declare their needs (`export
# const needs`, lib/plan.mjs). --list prints it; tests/desktop/run.test.ts holds it to the specs.
